# jellyfin_security_plugin_configuration (Resource)

Manages the JellyfinSecurity plugin configuration with typed attributes.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `plugin_id` (String) The plugin ID (GUID).

### Optional

- `allow_admin_password_login` (Boolean) Allow password login for administrators.
- `allow_indefinite_trust` (Boolean) Allow indefinite trust for devices.
- `allow_password_login_on_lan` (Boolean) Allow password login on LAN.
- `allow_private_notification_targets` (Boolean) Allow private network notification targets.
- `audit_log_max_entries` (Number) Max audit log entries.
- `bare_device_id_bypass_enabled` (Boolean) Enable bypass for bare device IDs.
- `block_empty_password_login` (Boolean) Block login for users with empty passwords.
- `bypass_for_external_auth_providers` (Boolean) Bypass 2FA for external auth providers.
- `challenge_token_ttl_seconds` (Number) Challenge token time-to-live in seconds.
- `default_language` (String) Default language code.
- `default_max_concurrent_sessions` (Number) Default max concurrent sessions per user (0 = unlimited).
- `disable_password_login` (Boolean) Disable password login entirely.
- `email_otp_enabled` (Boolean) Enable email OTP.
- `email_otp_ttl_seconds` (Number) Email OTP time-to-live in seconds.
- `enable_password_recovery` (Boolean) Enable password recovery.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the plugin is enabled.
- `enforcement_scope` (String) 2FA enforcement scope: Optional, Admins, or All.
- `enrollment_deadline` (String) 2FA enrollment deadline (ISO-8601 or null).
- `exempt_administrators_from_lockout` (Boolean) Exempt administrators from lockout.
- `geo_ip_asn_db_path` (String) Path to GeoIP ASN database.
- `geo_ip_city_db_path` (String) Path to GeoIP city database.
- `geo_ip_country_db_path` (String) Path to GeoIP country database.
- `gotify_app_token` (String, Sensitive) Gotify app token.
- `gotify_url` (String) Gotify notification URL.
- `hibp_enabled` (Boolean) Enable Have I Been Pwned password check.
- `hide_builtin_forgot_password` (Boolean) Hide the built-in forgot password link.
- `hide_builtin_passkey_button` (Boolean) Hide the built-in passkey login button.
- `hide_builtin_two_factor_button` (Boolean) Hide the built-in 2FA login button.
- `impossible_travel_enabled` (Boolean) Enable impossible travel detection.
- `impossible_travel_max_kmh` (Number) Impossible travel max speed in km/h.
- `ip_ban_duration_hours` (Number) IP ban duration in hours.
- `ip_ban_enabled` (Boolean) Enable IP banning.
- `ip_ban_exempt_cidrs` (List of String) CIDR ranges exempt from IP banning.
- `ip_ban_failure_threshold` (Number) IP ban failure threshold.
- `ip_ban_failure_window_minutes` (Number) IP ban failure window in minutes.
- `lan_bypass_cidrs` (List of String) CIDR ranges that bypass 2FA on LAN.
- `lan_bypass_enabled` (Boolean) Enable LAN bypass for 2FA.
- `lockout_duration_minutes` (Number) Lockout duration in minutes.
- `login_links_below_quick_connect` (Boolean) Show login links below Quick Connect.
- `max_failed_attempts` (Number) Max failed auth attempts before lockout.
- `nat_hairpin_self_ip_bypass` (Boolean) Enable NAT hairpin self-IP bypass.
- `notify_email_addresses` (List of String) Email addresses to notify.
- `ntfy_password` (String, Sensitive) ntfy password for HTTP Basic auth.
- `ntfy_token` (String, Sensitive) ntfy access token; takes precedence over ntfy_username/ntfy_password.
- `ntfy_topic` (String) ntfy notification topic.
- `ntfy_url` (String) ntfy notification URL.
- `ntfy_username` (String) ntfy username for HTTP Basic auth; used only when ntfy_token is empty.
- `oidc_providers` (Attributes List) List of OIDC provider configurations. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--oidc_providers))
- `onboarding_password_min_length` (Number) Onboarding password minimum length.
- `onboarding_password_require_digit` (Boolean) Require digit in onboarding passwords.
- `onboarding_password_require_lowercase` (Boolean) Require lowercase in onboarding passwords.
- `onboarding_password_require_symbol` (Boolean) Require symbol in onboarding passwords.
- `onboarding_password_require_uppercase` (Boolean) Require uppercase in onboarding passwords.
- `pairing_code_ttl_seconds` (Number) Pairing code time-to-live in seconds.
- `password_login_exempt_cidrs` (List of String) CIDR ranges exempt from password login disable.
- `pre_verify_window_seconds` (Number) Pre-verify window in seconds.
- `registered_device_max_age_days` (Number) Max age in days for registered devices.
- `require_challenge_ip_match` (Boolean) Require challenge token IP to match request IP.
- `require_two_factor_to_disable` (Boolean) Require 2FA to disable the plugin.
- `self_service_step_up_mode` (String) Self-service step-up mode: Off, UserChoice, or Forced.
- `smtp_from_address` (String) SMTP from address.
- `smtp_from_name` (String) SMTP from name.
- `smtp_host` (String) SMTP server host.
- `smtp_password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password.
- `smtp_port` (Number) SMTP server port.
- `smtp_use_ssl` (Boolean) Use SSL for SMTP.
- `smtp_username` (String) SMTP username.
- `step_up_level` (String) Step-up level: Off, Destructive, AllConfigChanges, or Everything.
- `step_up_window_seconds` (Number) Step-up authentication window in seconds.
- `totp_issuer_name` (String) TOTP issuer name.
- `trust_cookie_ttl_days` (Number) Trust cookie TTL in days.
- `trust_forwarded_for` (Boolean) Trust X-Forwarded-For header.
- `trusted_proxy_cidrs` (List of String) Trusted proxy CIDR ranges.
- `user_emails` (Attributes List) User email mappings. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--user_emails))
- `webauthn_origins` (List of String) WebAuthn allowed origins.
- `webauthn_rp_id` (String) WebAuthn relying party ID.
- `webhook_ed25519_private_key` (String, Sensitive) Webhook Ed25519 private key.
- `webhook_headers` (List of String) Extra webhook headers, one "Name: Value" entry each.
- `webhook_secret` (String, Sensitive) Webhook signing secret.
- `webhook_url` (String) Webhook notification URL.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The plugin configuration resource identifier.
